source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
# Reporting injuries Reporting work-related accidents and illnesses is a requirement of the Occupational Health and Safety Act. Timely and accurate reporting of injuries and illnesses is necessary to identify hazards in the workplace. It helps to identify situations requiring prompt corrective action and injury prevention measures. In addition, injury reports are used to determine if an employer is doing a good job of keeping workplaces safe and injury-free. 1. # Reporting injuries
  • Report injuries to coworkers, to supervisors or to others as soon as possible
  • If your doctor will later analyse the case, it is essential to describe the injury as accurately as possible
  • If there are other workers who might have been affected, let other members of the team know, so that they can take preventative measures, if needed.
1. 1. # Reporting injuries
